description: This file defines the interface ConfigManagerInterface for configuration management in Drupal, including methods for loading, diffing, snapshotting, uninstalling configurations, and dependency management.

classes.name: ConfigManagerInterface
classes.description: Interface for configuration management in Drupal, defining methods for entity retrieval, diffing, snapshot creation, uninstalling, dependency management, and dependency analysis.

methods.name: getEntityTypeIdByName
methods.description: Returns the entity type of a configuration object given its name.

methods.name: loadConfigEntityByName
methods.description: Loads a configuration entity using its name.

methods.name: getEntityTypeManager
methods.description: Retrieves the entity type manager service.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Creates a Diff object comparing configuration data from two storages.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a configuration snapshot after import.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls configuration for a specified extension type and name.

methods.name: getConfigDependencyManager
methods.description: Creates and populates a ConfigDependencyManager object.

methods.name: findConfigEntityDependencies
methods.description: Finds config entities dependent on extensions or entities.

methods.name: findConfigEntityDependenciesAsEntities
methods.description: Finds config entities dependent on extensions or entities as entities.

methods.name: getConfigEntitiesToChangeOnDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Lists config entities to update or delete when dependencies are removed.

methods.name: getConfigCollectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about available configuration collections.

methods.name: findMissingContentDependencies
methods.description: Finds missing content dependencies declared in configuration entities.
